answer: Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the canyon audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, because each one must be independent on the glacier graph and each exposes its bond to the juniper slash if it rubber-stamps. A verdict only settles when 4 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
